title: agent.draining
description: The answer to agent.drain, written to the agent's own log once the socket's live calls have moved: it takes no new call, and each call it held went to another socket holding the agent or waits, parked, for the next one that registers.

AgentDraining.description: One socket let go of its calls without cutting them.

app.description: The socket that is leaving, as agent.registered named it.

env.description: The world it held the agent in.

handed.description: Live calls attached to another socket holding the agent.

parked.description: Live calls waiting for the next socket that registers the agent.
